title: Google Tabletop Turns Prompts Into Planning Tools
hook: Google just turned group planning into an AI-powered workspace.
script: Google just turned group planning into an AI-powered workspace. It’s called Tabletop, a Google Labs experiment where groups share one online space and ask an AI agent to build the tools they need. Instead of juggling chats, docs, and links, you can ask @tabletop to create an itinerary, a dinner poll, an expense splitter, or even a tournament bracket. Everyone in the space can edit together, like in a Google Doc. Google says the experiment is limited for now to U.S. users 18 and older through a waitlist. The bigger idea is simple but powerful: AI isn’t just answering questions anymore. It’s building the little apps your group actually needs, right in the moment.
